text:
I have to give two stars. Here’s why:

At first glance, everything looked great, so much so that I even offered to refer them to others. But once the interior dried, I saw the real results.

When they shampooed and conditioned my seats, they didn’t use a wet-vac to extract the moisture. Because of that, I now have more stains on my seats than I did before the wash.

I paid over $200 for the car to be soaked with chemicals and left to air dry. I also paid $75 dollars for a biohazard fee becuase of toddler urine accident in the back seat. I’ll pay a premium, but I expect premium results.

My dash and interior had visible residue and streaks. Even my windows somehow were messy after I finally got in the car and started driving.

Some areas were still completely wet, and I had to finish drying it myself. There were also missed spots that I was shocked to see were not hit on the seats.

Again, when you get a detail, everything is fresh, so you give the head nod, you say hey appreciate it and keep it moving becuase it looks good in the moment.

Had the stains been there before my service, I wouldn’t even waste my time writing this. It essentially felt like this was something I could’ve done myself.

I held off writing this to give it a chance to dry out fully, hoping I wouldn’t need to leave a negative review. They were polite and worked hard in the heat. The customer service is there when you call but the output needs to match.

Ultimately, The results didn’t match the price, and definitely didn’t earn the referrals I was ready to give them. Disappointing. *Pictures are after the chemicals have dried*

Poor communication.  Wanted an estimate for a full interior restoration.   Was told to see Marco. Went that same day, spoke to Marco.  He took pics and I left my contact info.  After a week, I text “owner” about estimate.  Owner said I never went to see Marco (??).  After a few texts back and forth (one producing the pics Marco took, to confirm that was my vehicle) she said she would have an estimate the next day.  “You have my word”.   It’s been a week now and haven’t heard from them.  She mentioned she has Covid (I had it twice) but there needs to be someone in charge to carry on the business, even if it’s just a text to say please bear with us.  Glad they are busy but I don’t beg anyone to take my money.  Looking elsewhere.  Funny, this place was recommended by a friend.  He’s left scratching his head. 😳

terrible place. unprofessional people. My threads came apart and I brought the seat to be sewn up again. At the reception the person only took one look. He said that the leather was too old and would tear again. without even figuring out what was damaged there. I suspect that all the positive comments were written by friends of the owners

The lady in the front office never answers the phone, only response through text. Quoted me a price without verifying other details so when I showed up, I was told that it was going to be an extra $150 than what I was quoted. Over priced in my option.
Called then emailed and nothing. Guessing they are too busy ?

I accepted the estimate but after taking my car in I got a call 4 days later when they finally got to it and said the estimate was now revised almost $1,000 more. They missed a straightforward aspect of the repair and so it felt a bit like a bait and switch. No consideration for my wasted time for the Ubers to go to and from the shop.

I decided to go with a different repair shop and given how long the car sat I asked for even a small charge to get it to the next location in my text wasn't even answered. Pretty spiteful. I would not recommend this facility. A shame. The previous reviews seemed good but I was treated pretty badly.

The guy named Phil could not seem to fix it and took over 2 weeks to repair. I paid good money for terrible service. Will never come back and I DO NOT RECOMMEND for transmission jobs. These guys are not specialists ironically.  Included is my picture of after 3-4 months it stated leaking again.

I went somewhere else and found out that nothing is wrong with my 1st gear. Only my clutch needed to be replace for $1k. The Owner of Hackler Transmission was lying and trying to rip me off. I saved $2k going somewhere else.
Employees are threatening. Would take business somewhere else.

I got an oil change here, and two weeks later, my oil change light came back on. When I checked the oil, it was still dirty, which didn’t make sense since I barely drive (work is only 5 minutes away). I went back to ask why my car was already needing another oil change, and instead of addressing the issue, they made me pay for another one. This makes me question whether they even changed the oil in the first place. I also took my other vehicle here for an oil change, and something happened with it as well. I won’t be going back again and wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone who values honesty and good service.
